title: fix(spec): a page label does not fill the untitled header of a record page
body:
Fixes #22536
Clause-②: no

On a record page, a `page:header` with no `title` is the sanctioned spelling for "the renderer derives the heading from the record" (`PageHeaderProps.title`, the maintainer ruling recorded in `component.zod.ts`). Studio's record-page seed writes exactly that header. `translatePage` filled the absent title with the pack's `pages.NAME.label`, so the record's name was replaced by the page's static label. This happened in every locale whose pack carries the label, including the `en` skeleton that `os i18n extract` writes. Nothing warned.

## The rule (triage ruling A, comment 6092658777)

`resolvePageHeaderTitle` (`packages/spec/src/system/i18n-resolver.ts`) no longer lets the bundle label fill an untitled root `page:header` when all three of these hold (`headerDerivesFromRecord`):

- the page's `type === 'record'`, read as served: a document with no `type` is not a record page;
- the page's `object` is a non-empty string;
- the header's `properties.recordChrome !== false`.

Everywhere else the label still fills an absent title, as before. That includes the existing `#22508` control fixture, a page with no `type` and no `object`, whose pin name now says "non-record page". An authored title, including one that restates the page `label`, follows the existing order unchanged. The docblock's order list carries the new condition in its step 3.

**Where the predicate comes from.** objectui is read at the `.objectui-sha` pin `47b1f0bb71`:

- `PageHeaderRenderer` draws the record-derived heading only when a record context is mounted and the header keeps its record chrome (`containers.tsx:2331`-`:2332`, `:1573`-`:1574`).
- Two hosts mount that context: the record route, for the page `usePageAssignment` picks (`usePageAssignment.ts:139`-`:140`: `type === 'record'` and `object` naming the route's object), and the Studio preview (`PagePreview.tsx:186`-`:187`, `:311`).
- The one host this rule cannot see is a `type: 'modal'` action that renders its target page inside the invoking record's context (`useActionModal.tsx`, `RecordDetailView.tsx:3064`). Such a page keeps today's fill. Triage accepted this gap, and its in-repo population is 0.

Docs: `content/docs/ui/translations.mdx` states the exception beside the label-fallback sentence.

## Measured at the door

These are one-shot runs and were never committed. `GET /api/v1/meta/:type/:name` goes through `RestServer`, using the `meta-plural-i18n.test.ts` harness shape, on both the cached and uncached branches. The page is the Studio-seed shape: `account_record`, `type: 'record'`, `object: 'account'`, and a root `page:header` with properties `{recordChrome: true}`.

| pack, locale | before (`main` d6c37919c7) | after (cdfc9efa7a) |
| --- | --- | --- |
| zh-CN pack with only `pages.account_record.label` (客户记录页), zh-CN | header gains `title: 客户记录页` | header `{recordChrome: true}`, no title |
| `en` extract skeleton (`label: Account Record`), en | header gains `title: Account Record` | header `{recordChrome: true}`, no title |
| no `en` pack, en | untouched | untouched |
| control: `type: 'app'` page, untitled header with `recordChrome: false`, zh-CN | gains `title: 落地页` | gains `title: 落地页` (unchanged) |

The resolver, its tests, `component.zod.ts` and `page.zod.ts` are byte-unchanged between d6c37919c7 and this branch's merge base.

## Pins (`packages/spec/src/system/i18n-resolver.test.ts`)

Each pin runs at a region root and at a slot root.

- The Studio-seed record header stays untitled with the zh-CN label-only pack and with the `en` extract skeleton, and the page's own `label` still translates.
- A bundle `subtitle` still applies beside the untitled header.
- The pin also goes through `translateMetadataDocument`, the function the REST page doors call.
- One control per condition, where the label DOES fill: `type` absent, `object` absent or `''`, and `recordChrome: false`. A further control covers an object-bound page of another `type` (`list`, `app`, `home`, `utility`).
- An authored title on a record page follows the existing order: a template is kept, a title that restates the label takes the label translation, and a pack `title` replaces it.
- The existing `#22508` control is kept as written: a header with no title on a non-record page shows the bundle `label`.

**Ablation.** This ran at cdfc9efa7a with the fix committed, using `node scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`. It turned `if (own === undefined) return derivesFromRecord ? undefined : bundleLabel;` into `if (own === undefined) return bundleLabel;`. The anchor went from 1 to 0 hits, and the blob moved from c0682db53c44 to 69817db5e283. Result: `Tests 9 failed | 349 passed (358)`. The 9 failures are exactly the record-page pins (4 per root plus the `translateMetadataDocument` pin), and every control stayed green. The file was restored with blob c0682db53c44 equal to HEAD, and `git diff HEAD` is empty.

## Verification

All runs went through `scripts/pm/os-verify-lock.sh` with slot `issue-22536`. Each result is the `VERDICT command-exit` line of its run.

- `@objectstack/spec`:
  - `i18n-resolver.test.ts` plus `translation.test.ts` at d841d2686f (after the `main` merge): 505 passed.
  - `pnpm test` at cdfc9efa7a: 638 files, 19037 passed, 1 todo.
  - `pnpm typecheck` at cdfc9efa7a: green. The test-typecheck ledger held at 52 files, 246 errors and 135 signatures.
  - `build && check:generated` at d841d2686f: all 15 generated artifacts up to date.
- The only runtime caller of the translators is `@objectstack/rest` (`meta-item-read-gate.ts`), via `translateMetadataDocument`. Its consumer runs, all at cdfc9efa7a:
  - `pnpm test`: 269 files, 4979 passed, 326 skipped.
  - `pnpm typecheck`: green, with 0 test-layer errors.
  - `pnpm test:repo`: 191 passed, 1 skipped.
- `@objectstack/cli` unit tier, `test/platform-page-i18n-parity.test.ts` and `test/i18n-extract.test.ts`: 51 passed. These call `translatePage` on the shipped platform pages.
- Gates: `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` at d841d2686f derived 107 commands. 106 were run and all exited 0. `check:skill-examples` first exited 3 (PREREQUISITE NOT MET: `client-react` was unbuilt) and exited 0 after `turbo run build --filter='@objectstack/client-react...'`. `pnpm check:dual-build-cjs-loads`: NOT MEASURED, because the dispatch rules out a whole-workspace build. `--ran` reconciliation: 107 derived, 106 run, 1 unrun (that one). Artifact rosters block: 48 of 51 run, all exit 0. The 3 PR-context guards (`check-closing-target-claim`, `check-partof-closing-keyword`, `check-single-claim-paths`) are run against this PR after it opens, and their results are reported on the card.

## Acceptance notes

- **Seam: `PageSchema`'s parse default against `type` read as served.** This is reported, not fixed here. `PageSchema` defaults an absent `type` to `'record'` (`page.zod.ts:1177`).
  - Stored path: closed. A page saved without `type` is stored with `type: 'record'`, and a stored row without it is served with it (`withDeclaredPageTypeDefault`). Its 9 existing pins pass here.
  - Registry path: open. Measured through the door, a page registered in the `SchemaRegistry` without `type` and without a parse is served with no `type`. In zh-CN its untitled header gains the label (`title: 打包无类型页`). The same page as a stored row is served `type: "record"`, and its header stays untitled.
  - No real producer was found that registers a typeless page without parsing. `defineStack` applies the default, and the plugin pages in this tree declare `type`. Reach is therefore not established.
- **`recordChrome` spelling.** Only `properties.recordChrome` is read. Measured: `PageSchema` refuses a bare top-level `recordChrome` on a component (`unrecognized_keys` at `regions.0.components.0`), so a valid served document never carries it. Reading that spelling would be consumer tolerance for a key the contract refuses.
- **Unchanged on purpose.** A pack's `pages.NAME.title` and `subtitle` still apply to an untitled record-page header (step 1). Triage ruled on the label alone.
- **Population.** `showcase_task_detail` is the one in-repo record page with an untitled root header. No in-repo pack carries its label today, so nothing in-repo renders differently. The plugin-approvals record page that landed on `main` during this work is `kind: 'slotted'` with no header slot, so the server sees no root header on it.
